title: Binance users withdraw $5bn in wake of hack
text: Binance users have withdrawn nearly $5 billion from the crypto exchange since it reopened after the hack last week that saw North Korea-linked crooks make off with $6.3 billion.

title: OPay withdraws planned $304m US IPO after regulatory inquiry
text: OPay Limited has announced that it will be terminating its underwriting agreement and shelving plans for an initial public offering (IPO) on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) following a regulatory inquiry in a foreign jurisdiction the company described as “immaterial” to its core business.

title: Regulator warns Australians about 'highly speculative' prediction markets
text: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) says it is "not currently convinced" that prediction markets for retail clients are in the public interest, warning that people who access offshore platforms do not have legal protections.
